title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-01 current SGA working record: SGA 6 through source page 422
description:
Working SGA translation and source-checking record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record collects existing public SGA translations and the current source-checked SGA 5/6/7 working streams.

Status at a glance. [##########] SGA 5 source-checked stream: complete through page 484; [#######---] SGA 6 strict stream: bilingual reconstruction through source page 422; [###-------] SGA 7-I working stream: partial English draft through Expose IX section 6.6. For SGA 6 the next continuation point is source page 423.

Latest update. The SGA 6 cumulative French and English readers now run through source page 422, with individual Expose VI pages 397-422 readers plus source-scan witnesses. The artifact ZIP is intentionally compact: TeX sources, manifests, build logs, and scripts; bulky render/image provenance is kept in the main raw/source provenance lane instead of being re-uploaded into this satellite record each round.
notes: Latest update promotes SGA 6 cumulative readers through source page 422 and switches the satellite artifact to a compact TeX/manifests/logs archive.
